items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against contribution assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 21.05.2026; as a social-insurance letter posted in Germany it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting under §37 Abs. 2 SGB X, i.e. Mon 25.05.2026 (a public holiday, Pfingstmontag, but this day does not shift for the deemed-delivery rule). The one-month Widerspruch period of §84 SGG starts the next day (§187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number: Thu 25.06.2026. That day is a normal working day, so no further shift applies.

items.title: First monthly contribution collected by direct debit
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Freiwillige Mitgliedschaft, and with it the contribution obligation, begins 01.06.2026. The letter states contributions are collected on the 15th of the month following the month they cover. The first contribution (for June 2026) is therefore collected on 15.07.2026, and the same amount recurs by direct debit on the 15th of every following month (16.08., 15.09.2026, etc.) for as long as the membership continues; no separate action by the member is needed beyond ensuring the account is covered.

warnings: The one-month Widerspruch deadline against this contribution assessment (25 June 2026) has already passed as of today (26 September 2026); a Widerspruch filed now would normally be considered late unless grounds for Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand apply.
Contributions are collected monthly by direct debit on the 15th of the following month (not just once); make sure the account underlying the Lastschrift mandate has sufficient funds each month.
